label: the claim seam reads the branch tip again: a claim whose output the merge with origin/main moves passes the lane, then the merge gate sends the PR back (rn-design-pass #812, rn-empty-hint #766)
the pre-push body-identity guard removed: a body rewritten after the seam read it is pushed and uploaded unchecked
an existing PR skips the body upload again: GitHub keeps a body no seam passed and the merge gate sends the PR back
the merge worktree stops carrying ignored paths: a claim that reads a built bundle the lane holds goes red in the lane while the merge gate accepts it
the existing-PR upload guard removed: a hand-off snapshot changed after the seam read it replaces the live body unchecked
the conflict fallback reports a bare OK again: a claim proven on the branch tip is read as proven on the tree the merge gate will read
old: claim_note=" (merge with origin/main not materialized; the branch tip was checked — a conflict is merge.sh's verdict)"

label: the ignored-path carry follows a committed symlink ancestor: it writes the carried link beside the temporary merge worktree instead of staying inside it
the hand-off uploads the worker's mutable body again instead of the private snapshot the claim seam proved
the existing-PR upload hands gh the mutable source instead of the snapshot: a source rewrite during the push reaches GitHub unchecked
the bounded retry re-checks the first snapshot instead of re-snapshotting a mid-hand-off body fix
the producer opens the PR without running the claim seam: a false prose body the merge gate would reject becomes a PR (the #828 rework round)
the producer ignores the seam's exit code and accepts any verdict: CLAIM_LANE_FAIL opens the PR the merge gate then sends back
old:
if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] || [ -z "$verdict" ]; then
    rm -rf "$tmpdir"
    printf 'PRODUCER_PR_REFUSED: %s\n' "${verdict:-${out:-the claim seam gave no verdict (exit $rc)}}"
    return 1
  fi
  case "$verdict" in
    CLAIM_LANE_OK:*|CLAIM_LANE_NA:*|CLAIM_LANE_WAIVED:*) ;;
    *)
      rm -rf "$tmpdir"
      printf 'PRODUCER_PR_REFUSED: %s\n' "$verdict"
      return 1
      ;;
  esac
new:
if [ -z "$verdict" ]; then
    rm -rf "$tmpdir"
    printf 'PRODUCER_PR_REFUSED: %s\n' "${out:-the claim seam gave no verdict}"
    return 1
  fi

label: the producer's always-publish edit hands gh the mutable source body instead of the private snapshot the seam read: a rewrite during the seam reaches GitHub
a producer re-run for an already-open PR skips the body edit again: gh_pr_create returned the existing URL without uploading, so GitHub keeps a body no seam passed
the producer stops accepting a code-only NA verdict: a PR that needs no claim check is refused instead of opened
the producer never loads lane-pr.sh, so a transient gh create failure is not retried and the round is lost
the producer accepts a passing verdict even when the seam exited non-zero: a checker that crashed after printing opens the PR
